excerpt.zh: 我们可以根据自身利益来操控某个宇宙风暴的移动路线。可以将风暴驱斥远离我方恒星系，或是吸引风暴进而利用其正面效果。
excerpt.en: We can manipulate the path of a Cosmic Storm for our own benefit. Either to deflect them away from our systems, or attract them to utilize their positive effects.
